Shadow Eval is a production shadow-evaluation service (Python, FastAPI, SQLite, Docker) that replays live requests against candidate models without affecting users, with blinded pairwise evaluation, statistical regression gates, PII redaction, and cost tracking. It correctly flagged an injected regression across 80 paired evaluations at a one-sided p-value of 8.27×10⁻²⁵.

LiveCanvas is a self-hosted real-time collaborative whiteboard (TypeScript, React, Node.js, Yjs, Redis, PostgreSQL, Docker) with CRDT-synced drawing, cursors and presence, offline edits persisted via IndexedDB and auto-merged on reconnect, load-balanced across Node.js replicas behind Nginx.

Aegis is an incident-remediation platform (Next.js, Fastify, pgvector, Temporal, OpenAI, Kubernetes) that ingests signals from 4 sources with hybrid pgvector + OpenAI embeddings and runs human-gated remediation workflows that execute scoped Kubernetes actions with full audit trails.

PrivateText is a PII-redaction service (PyTorch, Torch-TensorRT, FastAPI, Modal): a fine-tuned classifier compiled with Torch-TensorRT FP16, cutting P50 latency 4.7x at 90.1% F1, deployed on Modal serving character-accurate entity spans.

Triage is a support-ticket priority classifier (PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, FastAPI, Modal): fine-tuned then quantized to INT8 ONNX, cutting latency from 32.75ms to 17.15ms, achieving 53.3% macro F1 on 6,000+ class-imbalanced tickets.

InferenceBench is a benchmarking harness (Python, Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) comparing LLM inference backends under matched model, prompt, and hardware conditions, with an interactive dashboard normalizing latency, throughput, and memory across five backends.

Cutdown is a multimodal video-clip ranker (FastAPI, Next.js, FFmpeg, PyTorch) combining transcript scoring, frozen embeddings, and a trainable ranker head, with a full upload-to-export pipeline evaluated against human-rated highlight clips.

AskMyDB is a natural-language SQL analytics copilot (FastAPI, OpenAI, PostgreSQL, React, Docker) using OpenAI function calling with read-only SELECT validation, hitting 93% accuracy, auto-rendering charts, containerized via Docker Compose and deployed on Railway.

Forge fuses GPT-2 attention kernels with Triton (PyTorch, Triton, CUDA, NVIDIA A100), delivering a 1.83x forward-pass speedup and 2x memory bandwidth, profiled with NVIDIA NCU to improve kernel pipelining, prefetch stages, and SRAM reuse.

Surge extends vLLM's paged-attention serving for Llama-3-8B (Python, vLLM, CUDA, Kubernetes), increasing throughput 2.4x at 100ms p99 latency by optimizing in-flight batching and KV-cache eviction under bursty single-GPU load.

Squelch applies post-training INT8 quantization to Whisper-small speech recognition via TensorRT (Python, PyTorch, TensorRT, ONNX), cutting latency 2.7x at only 0.3 WER degradation, profiled with NVIDIA Nsight to remove throughput regressions.
